children.innerHTML: Email or text us three things and get a confirmed price back within the hour, working days. No site visit, no obligation, no follow-up campaign.
Beds and baths. '2 bed 1 bath' is a complete sentence.
Which clean: Standard, Deep, or Move-out. Unsure? Say so; we'll ask two questions.
Postcode and the week you'd like. Photos welcome, chaos unjudged.
Reply lands within one working hour, price confirmed
If anything on the checklist isn't done to your standard, tell us within 48 hours and we return to fix it free. Used by 3% of clients, honoured for 100% of them.
Do I need to be home?
No. Most clients hand over a key or code, which lives in a sealed, numbered pouch, never labelled with your address.
Ours, eco-certified, included in the price. Got a beloved special-case spray? Leave it out and tell us; we're not proud.
Introduce us on visit one. By visit three the dog considers the vacuum a colleague. Cats will supervise from furniture regardless.
From the app or by text, up to 24 hours ahead, no fee, no guilt. Your cleaner gets paid either way; that's our cost, not yours.
